paragraphs: I am applying for the Associate role in the Financial Institutions Group in New York. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli after roles at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. A growing FIG team that works in small client teams on strategic and financing assignments across banks, specialty finance, FinTech and insurance is where I want to build my banking career, and my time at an asset manager and in finance operations gave me a close view of how financial institutions run.

My core modeling and valuation work is the best evidence of fit. I valued J.M. Smucker using equity and enterprise value bridges and trading comps, built a DCF with WACC, terminal value and sensitivity analysis that I matched against a sell-side model, and built an LBO while analyzing packaged-food precedent transactions in Capital IQ. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in capital deployment strategies and performed due diligence and peer benchmarking that identified 30% efficiency gains.

Those skills map to the pro forma, comparable company and precedent transactions analyses and the diligence your associates lead. I have also prepared executive-level presentations for senior leadership and data-driven pitch materials at Lenovo, so I am comfortable turning analysis into a clear story for senior audiences. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to the team.
